LanguageData.MST.partsComment: The body part tree of this body. Click to open the tree editor where you can add, remove, reorder and edit the parts (and the BodyPartDef they reference).
LanguageData.MST.defComment: The BodyPartDef this node references. Click "->" to jump to its data on the BodyPart tab.
LanguageData.MST.customLabelComment: Optional per-body label overriding the BodyPartDef label. Leave empty to use the def label.
LanguageData.MST.coverageComment: Fraction (0-1) of the parent's remaining coverage this part occupies.
LanguageData.MST.heightComment: Height category used when selecting this part to hit (Top/Middle/Bottom).
LanguageData.MST.depthComment: Depth category used when selecting this part to hit (Outside/Inside).
LanguageData.MST.groupsComment: Body part groups this node belongs to (used by apparel/armor coverage).
LanguageData.MST.BodyPartTreeHint: Right-click a part to add/remove/edit; drag to reorder or reparent; double-click to rename. Warning: Do not make any modifications after the game has started!
